root_idea.summary: The root centers on gentleness and careful, refined action, alongside smallness, lightness, or fineness in a thing.
root_idea.development: From the notions of gentle treatment and fine or slight quality develop the senses of subtle perception, unobtrusive efficacy, courtesy, delicate handling, gifts offered graciously, and related derived actions.

senses.definition: To act with care and gentleness; to proceed cautiously and tactfully.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for deliberately conducting oneself with لطف in a matter or toward someone. The Quranic occurrence is an exhortation to take care in one's conduct.

senses.definition: Gentle, gracious, and kindly disposed in dealing with creatures.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic nominal form, used as a divine attribute, especially with reference to God's gentle care, favor, and guidance of His servants.

senses.definition: Subtle and penetrating into the hidden intricacies of things; able to bring about effects through fine or unobtrusive means.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic nominal form, an attribute of God referring to knowledge of what is subtle or beyond ordinary perception and to the delicate realization of what He wills. This includes the subtle bringing about of an intended outcome.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be small or little; to be slender, thin, or fine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a thing in respect of size, thickness, or fineness.
A quality of form or manner distinct from mere smallness or thinness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a medicine, to act as an attenuant or emollient.
To make something slender or thin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form II use concerning reduction of thickness or bulk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To caress, soothe, coax, or cajole; to treat someone with gentleness, goodness, and affection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes speaking softly or blandly and behaving considerately toward another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone a gift or present.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction أَلْطَفَهُ بِكَذَا can denote presenting him with something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To show someone kindness, goodness, affection, and regard for his circumstances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV interpersonal use; in constructions with بِكَذَا it may overlap with presenting something to the person.
A noun of courteous and considerate treatment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Delicacy or refinement of flavor and the like.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A sensory or qualitative use referring to fineness rather than interpersonal gentleness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gift or present sent to another person as a token of courtesy or honor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: لَطَفَةٌ may denote the individual present; its plural is أَلْطَافٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Gentle, gracious, courteous, benignant, or refined in manners.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical adjective commonly applied to a person; this human-directed application is distinct from the Quranic divine epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Obscure, recondite, or abstruse in language or expression.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to language whose subtle meaning is difficult to grasp.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Delicate when applied to a medicine or similar substance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use concerning a medicine's fine or delicate quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A subtle, witty, quaint, or facetious saying, expression, allusion, or conceit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also an indication of a subtle meaning apparent to understanding but difficult to express, including a nicety of language.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lightness of movement and the undertaking of delicate or fine matters.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical derivational use describing slight motion or careful engagement with subtle affairs.
A rare specialized usage explicitly restricted to a female subject.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Restates the careful, gentle conduct sense.

cautions: The seven Quranic occurrences of لَطِيف in this packet are divine attributes; broader human-directed, linguistic, medicinal, and other specialized applications are therefore kept under other classical meanings.
